title: Using Claude/Fable 5.2 to make real world height work while keeping my sim flat
author: Ok-Pirate5732
selftext:
I was dreading working on ACT 2 of my Mongol Invasion of Vietnam hero defense game, because it takes place in the mountains (as opposed to ACT 1's village) and up until this point, the height map and simulation were flat and simple. 

When the new Fable came out, I said what the hell, might as well start now. 

What you're seeing is a the WIP of a major refactor to add height (towers, elevation, mountain paths, etc) while the sim still stays completely flat. Positions, hits and the network data are all still 2D. Height is still never stored on an entity and never sent over the network.

The terrain itself was actually handcrafted with the Terrain3d plugin for Godot, while the mountain related props used Meshy as a starting point. Fable also "fixed" the waterfall you see here, I could not get a decent looking one myself lol 

There's still quite a bit of jank right now (as I'm sure you'll see in the video) but it's been a while of grinding on this and I wanted to show it off! I've also got my blinders on staring at this for so long, so any feedback is much appreciated, thank you!

If you're interested, the game is called [100 Bodies in the Grass](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5357660/100_Bodies_in_the_Grass/), takes place in 1287 during the 3rd Mongol Invasion of Vietnam, and there is a demo on Steam out
